white_space: No single competitor integrates full inventory awareness with automated weekly meal planning (F16).
Apps like MealLoop (C:MealLoop) offer planning but do not track existing inventory, while PantryGenie (C:PantryGenie) tracks inventory but lacks a weekly planning calendar.
pricing_anchors: The current market price band is EUR 2.99 to EUR 6.99 per month, with a median stated willingness to pay of EUR 3.50 per month (S05). Any pricing above this band is considered untested (F17).
